title: Sidewalk shed parapet panel material.
officialText:
Sidewalk shed parapet panels shall be constructed out of a durable and
weatherproof material such as vinyl, plastic, or aluminum, and such material shall be flame retardant in accordance with NFPA
701 or listed under UL 214.
